scenes.headline: How Ling-3.0-flash stretches toward a million tokens
scenes.sub: Hybrid linear attention over a 512-expert mixture, from inclusionAI
scenes.say: Hi, I'm Puffin! Ling-3.0-flash is a hundred-and-twenty-four-billion-parameter open model that aims at a million-token context. Here's the stack that makes that cheap.

scenes.text: Five of every six attention layers keep a fixed-size memory instead of a growing cache. The sixth keeps full attention for exact recall.
scenes.say: The idea: five of every six attention layers keep a fixed-size memory instead of a growing cache. The sixth keeps full attention, for exact recall.

steps.say: A token climbs seven groups. Each is five linear attention blocks, then one full attention block.

steps.note: a fixed-size state, updated in place
steps.say: The five are Kimi Delta Attention. Instead of a cache that grows every token, each keeps a fixed-size state and rewrites it.

steps.note: full attention with a compressed cache
steps.say: The sixth is gated latent attention: real full attention with a compressed cache, so the forgetful layers have something exact to anchor to.
Every block ends in five hundred and twelve experts. Eight fire per token, plus one shared expert, so each token uses only about five billion parameters.

scenes.title: Inside one KDA layer
scenes.text: S_t = Diag(α_t) S_t-1 + β_t k_t v_tᵀ
scenes.say: Here's what a KDA layer does with each token.

parts.note: erase: a gated decay of the old state, per channel
parts.say: First it erases a little: a learned gate decays the old state, channel by channel.

parts.note: write: the new key and value, the delta rule
parts.say: Then it writes the new key and value. That's the delta rule.

parts.note: a fixed d by d matrix, however long the context
parts.say: The state never grows, so these layers run in linear time and constant memory.

scenes.title: SWE-Bench Pro, inclusionAI's launch report
scenes.note: vendor numbers: read them as directional
scenes.say: On inclusionAI's own coding numbers, it edges the field on SWE-Bench Pro, including its one-trillion-parameter sibling. Treat those as vendor numbers.

scenes.text: Cheap, forgetful layers plus one exact layer in six: most of full attention's fidelity, at a fraction of its memory.

recap: Five KDA layers keep a fixed-size state
One Gated MLA layer per group recalls exactly
Eight of 512 experts fire per token
scenes.say: To recap: a fixed-size state in five layers, one exact layer in six, and eight experts out of five hundred and twelve.
